ideas.title: One long room, one long table
ideas.grid: Week 1 is the top row, pinned after Friday 6 Nov.
ideas.cover: One long room, one long table.
ideas.caption:
A long, narrow condo, and a table that runs the same way.
Kitchen and dining share one strip of floor, so we set the table along the room, not across it.
Stone top [check], steel base, and the wine fridge built into the cabinets.
Long table or round?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #diningroom

ideas.title: The living room
ideas.grid: Week 1 is the top row, pinned after Friday 6 Nov.
ideas.cover: Soft colours, warm light, nothing loud.
ideas.caption:
The living room in this condo: soft colours, warm light, nothing that shouts.
We kept the TV wall bare, fixed the speaker bar under the screen, and ran a strip of light beneath the stone console [check].
The fluted wall on the side hides something. Friday.
Warm light or white?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #livingroom

ideas.title: There's a door in this wall
ideas.grid: Week 1 is the top row, pinned after Friday 6 Nov.
ideas.cover: There's a door in this wall.
ideas.caption:
Swipe once: the door is part of the fluted wall.
We ran the same panels across the door, with no frame or handle to give it away.
Behind it: [check: the room].
Did you spot it before you swiped?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #hiddendoor

ideas.title: The small things
ideas.grid: Week 2 is the bottom row.
ideas.caption:
The small things in this condo, up close.
Alabaster wall lights with a brass band [check], a lit niche over the stone console, two globe lights set into the shelf column, and a pendant by the bed.
All of them give a low, warm light for the evenings.
Which one would you take home?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #lightingdesign

ideas.title: A bedroom for sleeping
ideas.grid: Week 2 is the bottom row.
ideas.caption:
A bedroom for sleeping: grey, low light, nothing bright at eye level.
Fluted panels behind the bed, a pendant on each side instead of table lamps, and lights inside the glass wardrobe, so you can find a shirt without the ceiling light on.
Grey bedroom or white?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #bedroomdesign

ideas.title: The ceiling that rises
ideas.grid: Week 2 is the bottom row.
ideas.cover: The ceiling rises as the room opens.
ideas.caption:
In a long, narrow condo, the ceiling does some of the work.
We curved the false ceiling [check: from where to where] and hid a strip of light along its edge, so the room seems to open up as you walk in.
Curved or straight?
#condorenovation #singaporeinteriordesign #sginterior #falseceiling
